summary: Completed frontend-only Phase 7 public shell regression on localhost:3000. Target public routes rendered, critical data-testid interactions were present and functional, CTABanner internal links stayed SPA-safe (no beforeunload), and embed/channels/checkout/contact/faq flows were validated.

issues: Secondary CTA ('Check Readiness') uses dark blue text on dark navy background; contrast appears weak for accessibility.

action_items: Improve contrast for home hero secondary CTA styling.
Optional: if product expects visible register actions when events list is empty, add explicit empty-state CTA on /events.
critical_code_review_comments: CTABanner LinkComponent integration remains React Router-friendly; no full-page reload observed during CTA navigation.
Runtime env wiring appears effective in active runtime: app booted at :3000 without manual shell export and Supabase-config-dependent routes loaded.
Critical requested public interactions now have deterministic data-testid coverage across Home/Browse/PlayerDetail/Contact/Events/FAQ/Checkout/Watch/Embed docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated requested routes: /, /contact, /events, /faq, /checkout/recruiting-review, /watch, /watch/:slug (including not-found fallback), /embed/docs. Events register buttons were absent in current data state (count=0), while dashboard/services CTA links were present.
rca of the issue: No blocking regressions found. Minor accessibility issue reproduced by visual inspection and class usage on HomePage secondary hero CTA (`text-[#0134BD]` over `bg-navy-800`), likely causing low contrast.
